How can I get a distance?
Just do a long press in the map :)
How can I get a distance from my current position to any position in the map?
In the side bar, select "Current position" and then perform a long press on the desired place in the map.
How can I get a distance from any position to another position in the map?
In the side bar, select "Any position" and then perform a long press on the desired place in the map.
Do I need to grant "Location" permission to get distances from current point?
Do I need to grant "Location" permission to get distances from any point?
How can I create a multiple points distance?
Perform single clicks on the desired points and a long click on the last one.
How can I reset the status of the map?
Select any position mode in the side bar.
Why is my GPS position not accurate?
This issue could be related to your device GPS sensor.
